title: Anderson Mixing in Bures Wasserstein Space of Gaussian Measures
summary: Various statistical tasks, including sampling or computing Wasserstein barycenters, can be reformulated as fixed-point problems for operators on probability distributions. Accelerating standard fixed-point iteration schemes provides a promising novel approach to the design of efficient numerical methods for these problems.
